one_line: Stack the products on screen at second zero, then one top-down hands-only segment per item with word-by-word captions.

q1_hook.what: Eye-level medium shot, a smiling woman placing boxes on a growing tower of game boxes. Spoken (transcript) and subtitled word by word from 0:00: "שמונה משחקי קופסא", "של קודקוד לילדים", "מגילאי", "שאסור לכם לפספס".
q1_hook.why: A number plus "שאסור לכם לפספס" promises a list while the tower visibly grows (H1, T3). Face and voice open together and are subtitled at once, so it works with sound off (H4, H6). Boxes are handled from frame one (S1). The benefit (skills) arrives only from 0:10 (H2).

beats.what: She stacks the game boxes into a tower, smiling at the lens; list promise subtitled
beats.why: The number plus the growing stack shows a list is coming

beats.what: Top-down hand lifts items from the whale game with a rod
beats.why: The first game sets the pattern: name, play, why it is good

beats.what: Hats game: dice, swatters, a spread of patterned tiles
beats.why: New box, new colours and new hand action

beats.what: Turtle memory game: box, face-down cards, hands matching cards and figures
beats.why: The longest segment, but the hands keep moving

beats.what: Animals-in-glasses cards: box, decks, a hand lays shape cards
beats.why: A bright new box resets attention

beats.what: Buzzer game: balloon box, buzzer, a finger points along three cards
Pizza card game: topping cards laid in a row, then a pepper card
beats.why: A clear goal (build the pizza) is easy to follow

beats.what: Safari round cards, a finger points at animals
Back at the tower, laughing: "כמרפאה בעיסוק"
beats.why: Her credential arrives late, after the value

beats.what: Handheld top-down drift over the boxes; "תעקבו אחרי"
beats.why: The products stay in frame while the ask appears

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "שמרי את הפוסט שתוכלי לשלוף כשתרצי לבחור משחק חדש" (save) and "ושלחי לחברה שחייבת לחדש מלאי לילדים שלה" (send). No question.
q2_flow.why: Each game is a new box and layout every 5 to 10 s, and the shared pattern makes it easy to follow (R3, E2). The spoken facts are skill lists over hands with no reaction (R3). The last 9 s are credential and follow ask (R1, E8). Seven games get a segment, not the eight promised.

q3_cta.what: On screen 1:06: "תעקבו אחרי ✨", after subtitled lines (1:02 to 1:05) promising more child-development content and tips. Caption: follow the account, save the post, send it to a friend. No link or where to buy.
q3_cta.why: Follow comes after the value, has a reason (more tips), and is said and shown inside the safe zone (C6). Three actions in the caption break C1, but save and send name a friend and a purpose (C4, C2). Nothing leads to the games themselves.

q4_shown.what: The tower of boxes at 0:00. Then each game top-down from 0:04: the box, the pieces, one adult's hands playing a few moves, never a full round. Her credential is said at 0:58 (transcript). No child, price, link or screen recording.
q4_shown.why: Hands on the product in every segment make a clean demo (S4, F5), and a no-child Reel fits S5. The credential comes only at 0:58, after the skill claims, so authority arrives late (S6). Nothing is shown as a result.

q5_edit.what: About 11 shots in 67 s (about 6 s each), straight cuts between games, quick re-framing inside segments (first pass: about 21 cuts). No speed changes seen. Subtitles change about every second with the voice. Ends on a handheld drift.
q5_edit.why: One cut per new game keeps a moderate pace, and a new subtitle each second adds motion (E2, R3). Subtitles follow the voice in 1 to 4 word chunks, good for sound off (E4, T1) but sit on the products (T2). The last 9 s add no new information (E8).

q6_topic.what: A children's occupational therapist recommends eight board games by the skills each trains, for parents picking a game for a child aged 3 and up.
q6_topic.why: Saveable, practical value from a professional (K4, R7), tied to real parent concerns such as attention and impulse control (K6). The tone is cheerful but nobody reacts, so the feeling that makes people send a Reel is thin (K1, R5). An occasion appears only in the caption (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Intro and outro: static eye-level medium shot, same framing both times, bright room with a wall spinner, she looks at the lens. Demos: steady top-down on a pale table, hands entering from the edge. Last shot: handheld top-down drift. Daylight, sharp.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands show each game as the viewer would see it on their own table (F5, S4), and she speaks to the lens at both ends (F6, H4). Boxes and cards fill the frame, so box titles read (F4). Bright, sharp and phone-made (F7, H8, F1).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold word-by-word subtitles with emoji, 1 to 4 words, about 1 s each, centred at mid-frame, over the products: 0:00 "שמונה משחקי קופסא", 0:03 "שאסור לכם לפספס", 0:10 "למה כובע?", 0:32 "באזזזז", 0:59 "כמרפאה בעיסוק", 1:06 "תעקבו אחרי". No headline card, no price.
q8_text.caption: "אם את אמא לילד בן 3 ומעלה- הפוסט הזה במיוחד בשבילך!" About 300 words: Yom Kippur line, brand tag, follow ask, one paragraph per game with its skills, save and send asks, signature, 5 hashtags. No disclosure.
q8_text.why: Subtitles in the middle band clear the buttons and work muted (T1, T4, E4). Near-verbatim chunks cover the products (T2). The caption names its audience and uses searchable words (T7), but the Kodkod collaboration is only a tag, with no disclosure (T8, S7).

weak_points: Eight promised, seven demoed; 67 s with a 9 s tail; no child reaction; subtitles over the products; the collaboration with @mykodkod is not disclosed in words; a 300-word caption repeating the voice.
lumebook_takeaway: Stack printed LumeBook books on a table at 0:00, then one top-down page flip per book, hands only, one-line reason each.
not_verified: Music is not established (transcript is speech only). Whether the games were gifted or paid. The age number after "מגילאי" is not visible at 1 s sampling (caption says 3 and up; the 15 Oct breakdown reads "מגילאי 3"). Correction to src/coded: only seven games get a segment; an eighth box (a dog game) appears only in the stack and the final drift. Sub-second subtitle timing was not measured.
